title: Arming policy of one repository
description: One repository's arming policy: how a pull request reaches its default branch, mapped onto GitHub's merge settings but more abstract. The fleet default is policies/arming.json; a repository's own file (repos/<repo>.json in its organisation's agent-fabric-settings repository, registry settings_repos) merges over it, objects recursively and scalars replacing, so every field here is optional in a repository's file. The merged result is what fabric-pr arm judges a PR by and what fabric-repo-policy applies to GitHub and verifies.

description.description: Why this file says what it says; ignored by every reader.

mode.description: queue: GitHub's merge queue. auto: auto-merge once the required checks pass. direct: no server-side rule, the pre-push hook is the fence. owner-only: fabric-pr arm refuses, only the owner merges.

method.description: The one merge method the repository allows.

required_checks.description: Status checks that must pass before the merge; auto and queue need at least one, which lint checks on the merged policy.

context.description: The check's name as it reports on a commit.

app.description: The GitHub App that reports it, e.g. github-actions; absent, any.

deletion.description: The default branch cannot be deleted.

force_push.description: The default branch refuses a non-fast-forward push.

delete_branch_on_merge.description: GitHub deletes the head branch of a merged PR.

queue.description: Merge-queue parameters; read only in mode queue.

grouping.description: GitHub's grouping strategy: every entry in a build must be green, or only the group's head.

merge_max.description: Most entries merged in one group.

merge_min.description: Fewest entries merged in one group.

wait_minutes.description: Minutes to wait for merge_min entries.

check_timeout_minutes.description: Minutes before a queued build's checks time out.

commits.description: The work-commit count a PR needs before it is armed (agent-fabric ADR-019 rule 4).

advice_over.description: Work commits above which the gate advises splitting the PR.

below_min.description: A PR under the minimum: arm on the owner's word, or refuse.

roles.description: A different minimum for the author's role, by role slug.

classes.description: A different minimum for a stated Class: whose paths every changed file matches, by class name.

paths.description: Regular expression every changed file must match.

bots.description: What a bot's PRs may be armed without a person.

ecosystems.description: Dependabot package ecosystems armed; absent, all.

ruleset.description: Name of the one ruleset the fabric manages; any other is left alone.

branch.description: The branch the rules govern; absent, the registry's default_branch.
